sources.title: krea2-gguf · Model · Inferix
sources.snippet: This repository provides GGUF files for two checkpoints of the Krea 2 model family: krea2 raw bf16 .gguf — converted from krea/Krea 2 Raw, the base release checkpoint. krea2 turbo bf16 .gguf — converted from krea/Krea 2 Turbo, the post trained checkpoint with additional fine tuning and distillation.
